title: Consider renaming Test page lessonType or clarifying UX
body: The /test page now shows 'practice' lessonType content. This may be semantically confusing since a 'Test' page shows 'Practice' content. Consider either: (1) Renaming the page route to avoid confusion, or (2) Documenting that 'Test' is a practice/test mode, or (3) Creating actual 'exam' type lessons for courses.
rationale: The fix matches expected behavior per issue #1864, but the naming mismatch (Test page showing Practice content) may confuse future developers.
